audit: retail questy 89193 Arator, 86903 The Arcantina, 89388 Voidstorm

86903.tooltip_objective: Visit the Arcantina. Requirements: Sons of Lothar Teleport, Teleport to the Arcantina, [DNT] Sons of Lothar phasing - Position 2, A Round of Drinks, Approach with Drinks, [DNT] Joke, Drinks served x 4, [DNT] Shield Conversation, [DNT] Skip, Speak with Arator
86903.wiki_description_verbatim: $p, there's a place that we used during the Second War, when we missed our homes an' needed to remember Azeroth. Somethin' of a retreat an' a sanctuary for those who've seen too much fighting--too much pain. Over time, we've brought friends and allies there. In recent years, members o' the Horde have been invited as well. We call it the Arcantina. I believe Arator, and you, would benefit from some respite there. Use this key to make a portal.
86903.wiki_progress_verbatim: This really is quite the place, isn't it, $p?
86903.wiki_completion_verbatim: This has been a journey, $p. I've learned a lot from Alonsus, and the Sons of Lothar... And perhaps most of all, what kind of paladin my father used to be, and what sort I'll be from now on.
86903.db_ender_match_wiki: partially - wiki uvadza jedneho Aratora, DB ma 3 varianty (235479/236734/253988)
86903.db_offer_reward_text: This has been a journey, $p. ... (zhodne s wiki Completion)
86903.db_request_items_text: This really is quite the place, isn't it, $p? (zhodne s wiki Progress)
86903.verdict: OK s otaznikom - starter aj texty sedia; overit ci 3 Arator-enderi su zamer (fazy) alebo over-link

89193.wiki_description_verbatim: Archbishop Alonsus Faol has left a message asking to speak with you in regards to a project to help Arator and the Vanguard of Light.
89193.wiki_completion_verbatim: Thank you for coming, $p. I need your help, as do many of our priests and paladins. One paladin in particular.
89193.db_offer_reward_text: Thank you for coming, $p. I need your help... One paladin in particular. (zhodne s wiki Completion)
89193.verdict: BUG - chyba starter: ziadny creature_queststarter ani gameobject_queststarter pre 89193. Wiki Start = Scouting Map. Quest je bez startera neziskatelny (okrem test-kopie 89193000 cez 9100629).

89388.tooltip_objective: Speak with Magister Umbric in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon.
89388.wiki_note: Quest-stranka na Warcraft Wiki neexistuje (len zonova stranka https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Voidstorm, zona 15458). Giver/ender podla tooltipu + DB textov: Magister Umbric.
89388.db_log_description: Speak with Magister Umbric in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon.
89388.db_quest_description: Magister Umbric has a plan to infiltrate the Voidstorm and take the fight to the Devouring Host directly. This will be no easy task, and he is assembling a small but powerful team to strike at the enemy's heart.
89388.db_offer_reward_text: I hope you are ready for a challenge. This will not be easy.
